intro: Neakasa replaced the carbon filter on the M1 Plus with mechanical seals, and built in a mode for kittens, which changes a couple of the usual fixes. Being open-topped, it also has the scatter question every open box has.

facts.text: Supports cats from 3.3 to 33 lb, and up to three cats.
There is no carbon filter: odour is held back by a brush strip and a composite sealing ring.
Bags are Neakasa refill rolls, closed with a pull-and-wrap action.

symptoms.title: A kitten does not trigger the box
symptoms.summary: A small kitten uses the box but nothing registers.
causes: Neakasa rates the M1 Plus from 3.3 lb. Below that, Kitten Mode is meant to be used.

fixes.detail: Enable Kitten Mode in the Neakasa app for cats under 3.3 lb.

symptoms.escalate: If a cat over 3.3 lb is not registering, contact Neakasa.

symptoms.title: Smell or seepage despite no filter to replace
symptoms.summary: Odour or moisture escapes, and there is no filter to change.
causes: The brush strip or sealing ring is dirty or not seated.

fixes.detail: Clean the brush strip at the base of the litter bed and check the sealing ring is fully seated.

symptoms.escalate: If a clean, seated seal still leaks, contact Neakasa about replacement parts.

symptoms.title: Litter escapes the open top
symptoms.summary: Litter collects around the box because nothing encloses it.
causes: An open top cannot contain enthusiastic digging.

fixes.detail: Put a generous mat at the entrance and keep litter at the line rather than above it.

symptoms.escalate: Some scatter is inherent to open-top designs and is not a fault.
